tool_about: Spring-It-On computes underdamped, critical and overdamped step responses with its original scalar spring functions. Samples come from direct C++ execution. The wrapper omits only the raylib/raygui UI includes from common.h. Its numerical functions are unchanged. The driver checks settling and underdamped overshoot.
